title: ר' תנחום בריה דר' חייא איש כפר עכו

paragraphs: R' Tanhum son of R' Hiyya, the man of Kefar Akko: Berakhot 63b; Ta'anit 7b; Bekhorot 57, end of side b; Jerusalem Ta'anit. And Rav Aha, chief of the fortress. He said in R' Yaakov bar Aha's name: Mo'ed Katan 16, end of side b. When he died, all the statues were uprooted: Mo'ed Katan 25, end of side b. “Kefar Akko” is not there; Ein Yaakov has “of Kefar Akko.”
